map.输入性别、年龄、身高、体重与活动水平，按基础代谢与活动系数估算每日所需热量，辅助: Enter gender, age, height, weight and activity level to estimate daily calorie needs from BMR and the activity factor, assisting weight control and meal planning.
map.BMR(Mifflin) = 10×体重 + 6.25×身高 − 5×年龄 +: BMR(Mifflin) = 10×weight + 6.25×height − 5×age + (male 5 / female −161); TDEE = BMR × activity factor
map.默认 Mifflin-St Jeor 公式，另可选 Harris-Benedic: Defaults to Mifflin-St Jeor, with Harris-Benedict (male 66.5+13.75W+5.003H−6.755A) and Katch-McArdle (370+21.6× lean body mass, estimating body fat from BMI first) also available. Daily intake target = TDEE + target delta (cut / maintain / bulk); values are estimates.
map.减脂或增肌前先算基础代谢与每日消耗，据此设定每日热量目标。: Before cutting fat or gaining muscle, compute basal metabolism and daily expenditure, then set the daily calorie target from that.
map.对比不同活动水平下的总消耗，判断当前运动量是否足够。: Compare total expenditure at different activity levels to judge whether current exercise volume is enough.
map.配合 BMI 一起看，把体重目标拆解为可执行的每日摄入区间。: Combine with BMI to turn the weight goal into an executable daily intake range.
map.：男性、30 岁、175 cm、70 kg：Mifflin 公式 BMR = 1: : male, 30 years old, 175 cm, 70 kg: Mifflin BMR = 10×70 + 6.25×175 − 5×30 + 5 ≈ 1654 kcal; multiplied by a moderate activity factor of 1.55 gives TDEE ≈ 2564 kcal, and a −500 kcal fat-loss target gives about 2064 kcal per day.
map.：同一组参数下，Mifflin-St Jeor 与 Harris-Benedic: : with the same parameters Mifflin-St Jeor and Harris-Benedict usually differ by about 5% or less; Katch-McArdle needs body fat estimated from BMI and is less biased for muscular people, but depends on the accuracy of that estimate.
map.该选哪套 BMR 公式？: Which BMR formula should I use?
map.一般人群推荐 Mifflin-St Jeor；若已知较准的体脂率可选 Katch: For the general population Mifflin-St Jeor is recommended; if a reasonably accurate body fat percentage is known, Katch-McArdle is an option; for historical literature conventions use Harris-Benedict.
map.算出来的数值能直接照吃吗？: Can I follow the computed values directly in the diet?
map.仅供参考。实际消耗受个体代谢、睡眠与食物热效应影响，建议以此为起点，按 2–4: For reference only. Actual consumption varies with individual metabolism, sleep and the thermic effect of food, so use this as a starting point and fine-tune on 2–4 weeks of weight change.
map.活动系数怎么选？: How is the activity factor chosen?
map.久坐办公选较低档，每周规律训练 3–5 次选中档，体力劳动或高强度训练选高档；拿: Office workers with prolonged sitting should pick a lower level, regular training 3–5 times a week the middle level, and manual labour or high-intensity training the higher level; when unsure start conservatively.
